answer: An AI-agent economy monitoring an inlet, juniper scrub, and falcon nests resists Sybil attacks via Proof-of-Space-Time. Each node commits a Merkle root over a key-bound plot from a depth-robust graph and answers random leaf audits faster than on-the-fly recomputation. Because plots cannot be deduplicated across keys, attackers incur dedicated storage and I/O costs per identity, though cheap cloud SSDs and time-memory tradeoffs weaken deterrence against well-funded adversaries.
